description: For strict upper tails in any linear order, the ordinary intersection is empty and the diagonal intersection is the entire order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.tails_intersections.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] :
  ⋂ a, Set.Ioi a = ∅ ∧ (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.diagonalIntersection fun a => Set.Ioi a) = Set.univ
